subject.title: 自定义模型Openrouter升级后没有办法使用了

question: Should this misfiled OpenRouter regression be transferred to OpenClaw core or closed here with a redirect?
rationale: Graincrawl has no provider runtime, but transferring or closing an issue across repository boundaries is a human GitHub-administration choice.

options.title: Transfer to OpenClaw core
options.body: Preserve the existing report and discussion in the repository that owns provider loading.

options.title: Close with redirect
options.body: Ask the reporter to recreate the report in OpenClaw core with the missing reproduction evidence.

recommendation.title: Transfer to OpenClaw core
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing report and discussion in the repository that owns provider loading.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the issue’s current assignee and therefore the strongest immediate owner for the routing decision.
